Longitudinally tracked - new row(s) for each visit (or item), once a visit is finalized cannot modified. Not tracked over time, data is the most recent information as of when the data was exported. New entry for each item, but changes to the item are not tracked over time (data is the information as of when the data was exported). Static lookup Export File Formats: ● Clinical EHI Export data files are machine readable and are made available in pipe-delimited CSV file format file per table for the structured portion. These files are found in the “xxxx_data_extract” folder of the .zip file. ● Our export also includes, wherever relevant, additional human readable files in XML, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, JSON PDF formats, which contain patient health information. Examples include imaging results, scanned documents, etc. Lab, RX and other attachments are made available in the Attachments folder. Folder Structure: ● While the filenames are likely to change over time, the ehi_export.zip file generally has two folders files/ folders corresponding to the healthcare datasets exported: a. b. ehi_export/xxxx_data_extract: Contains all clinical and financial/billing files in the ehi_export/attachments: Contains all attachments (RX, Notes, Lab attachment, etc.) associated with the Database Tables & Columns:

Data for all patient and payer refunds. One row per refund id. In Practice Management there isn’t a direct link between a charge and a specific refund. To issue a refund, staff reverse allocated payments from the charge. Once funds are considered unallocated, then the staff can proceed with the refund. Two workflows: - Patient->Patient Financials->Payment Transaction->Create Refund - Practice Financials->Payer Payments->Payment Transaction->Payer Refunds
